seeds.summary: Customer requested a refund. The AI agent called a deprecated refund tool. SigNoz captured the telemetry. Flight Recorder replayed the incident, counterfactual analysis validated the fix, and root-cause investigation completed.

row.error: refund_api_v1 was decommissioned; refunds require refund_api_v2 with an approval token
row.root_cause: The support agent invoked the deprecated `refund_api_v1` tool. The refund service decommissioned that version in favour of `refund_api_v2` (which requires an approval token), but the agent's knowledge base still referenced the retired endpoint. Every attempt returned `404 Tool Deprecated`, so the refund could not be completed.
